Subject: Crewstone pilot playbook & decision checkpoints

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for a productive call this morning. Quick recap and proposed mutual action plan so we have shared milestones and owners. Please flag anything I mis-stated.

Key pain points you described:
- Current latency on categorical recommendation inference causes poor conversion spikes across peak hours.
- Operational cost for nightly batch retraining is ballooning as dataset grows.
- Lack of observable per-request cost and token-level breakdowns that block SRE buy-in.

Top goals for the 6-week pilot:
1) Reduce inference p99 latency by 20% on peak load for the product recommendation model.
2) Prove a 30% reduction in per-query cost using batching and prefix caching.
3) Produce an evaluation report with A/B metrics and an ops playbook for production rollout.

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (milestones & owners):
- Technical kickoff (scope review + infra checklist) — owner: Lauren Bishop — target: 2028-08-07
- Engineering validation (integration + small-scale load) — owner: Crewstone eng lead (Tom Ruiz) + Redwood SE — target: 2028-08-14
- Pilot start (full traffic split) — owner: Crewstone ops + Redwood runtime — target: 2028-08-21
- Pilot evaluation & metrics review — owner: Sarah Nolan + Lauren/SoJin — target: 2028-09-11
- Executive decision (go/no-go for production) — owner: Crewstone exec sponsor (Ken Abbott) — target meeting: 2028-08-30

Open items / asks:
- Please confirm procurement timeline and whether a PO is required before pilot start.
- Can you confirm the list of technical contacts who will join the kickoff (Tom + any others)?
- I've attached the initial MPA spreadsheet (Crewstone_MPA_v1.xlsx) and a SOW template for procurement.

Next step: If this looks right, can we lock the technical kickoff for the week of Aug 7? I can coordinate calendars once you confirm attendees.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
Redwood Inference
